searches.reason: Test whether reconstruction-to-inference mismatch limits next-item ranking despite strong training margins. Seek practical prefix-sampling and terminal-mask objectives; first compare a constant reconstruction/terminal mixture, then a curriculum, without exposing targets in bidirectional inputs.

searches.reason: Explore a structural way to distinguish current intent from stale interests: jointly learned relative-time attention or recency gates inside one BERT4Rec network. Compare against terminal-mask training alone using observed histories and timestamps; do not assume older interests are always irrelevant.
searches.query: bidirectional sequential recommendation BERT4Rec time aware relative attention adaptive recency gating interest drift 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Investigate discrimination among plausible alternatives rather than easy random negatives. Seek title/description-informed hard negatives and sampled ranking objectives with false-negative safeguards, using text features learned from supplied data within one jointly trained BERT4Rec model. Training margins and representation geometry motivate investigation but do not establish the cause of validation errors.
